title: GET parameter rule for $POST and $GROUP search results "&userid="
text:
## GET parameter rule for $POST and $GROUP search results "&userid="
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069993
The userid URL parameter can be used to filter Post and Group search results by the member who created them.
When a User ID is specified, the search results display only the posts created by that member.

## URL Format
Append the userid parameter to a Post or Group search results URL.
For example:
Replace 1 with the desired member's User ID.

## Find the Member's User ID
To locate a member's User ID, see:
How to View a Member's Unique ID Number in the Admin Area
